prompt: Name a capital city in Asia

answers.name: Tokyo
answers.fact: Was called Edo until 1868.

answers.name: Beijing
answers.fact: The first city to host both the Summer and Winter Olympics.

answers.name: Bangkok
answers.fact: Its full ceremonial name is one of the longest place names in the world.

answers.name: Seoul
answers.fact: About half of South Korea lives in its metro area.

answers.name: New Delhi
answers.fact: Built by the British and inaugurated as capital in 1931.

answers.name: Singapore
answers.fact: A city-state: the capital is the whole country.

answers.name: Naypyidaw
answers.fact: Myanmar's purpose-built capital, known for near-empty 20-lane highways.

answers.name: Ulaanbaatar
answers.fact: The coldest national capital in the world.

answers.name: Colombo
answers.fact: Sri Lanka's executive capital; parliament sits in Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte.

answers.name: Hanoi
answers.fact: Celebrated its 1,000th birthday in 2010.

answers.name: Manila
answers.fact: One of the most densely populated cities on Earth.

answers.name: Jakarta
answers.fact: Sinking so fast that Indonesia is building a new capital, Nusantara.

answers.name: Kuala Lumpur
answers.fact: Its name means 'muddy confluence'.

answers.name: Taipei
answers.fact: Taipei 101 was the world's tallest building from 2004 to 2009.

answers.name: Kabul
answers.fact: Sits about 1,800 m above sea level.

answers.name: Tehran
answers.fact: Ski slopes are about an hour's drive away.

answers.name: Baghdad
answers.fact: One of the world's largest cities in the 9th century.

answers.name: Riyadh
answers.fact: Its name comes from the Arabic for 'gardens'.

answers.name: Islamabad
answers.fact: Purpose-built in the 1960s to replace Karachi.

answers.name: Kathmandu
answers.fact: The Kathmandu Valley holds seven UNESCO-listed monument zones.

answers.name: Dhaka
answers.fact: Known as the 'rickshaw capital of the world'.

answers.name: Pyongyang
answers.fact: Its Ryugyong Hotel has stood mostly unfinished since 1987.

answers.name: Doha
answers.fact: Qatar's capital, at the heart of the 2022 World Cup.

answers.name: Abu Dhabi
answers.fact: The UAE's capital. Not Dubai.

answers.name: Muscat
answers.fact: Oman's capital, ringed by rugged mountains.

answers.name: Kuwait City
answers.fact: The Kuwait Towers are its emblem.

answers.name: Damascus
answers.fact: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

answers.name: Beirut
answers.fact: Legend says it has been destroyed and rebuilt seven times.

answers.name: Amman
answers.fact: Originally built on seven hills.

answers.name: Ankara
answers.fact: Became Turkey's capital in 1923. Not Istanbul.

answers.name: Phnom Penh
answers.fact: Sits where the Mekong and Tonlé Sap rivers meet.

answers.name: Baku
answers.fact: The lowest-lying national capital, about 28 m below sea level.

answers.name: Vientiane
answers.fact: Sits on the Mekong, looking across at Thailand.

answers.name: Thimphu
answers.fact: One of the few capitals with no traffic lights.

answers.name: Malé
answers.fact: A capital packed onto one small island.

answers.name: Bishkek
answers.fact: Was called Frunze in Soviet times.

answers.name: Tashkent
answers.fact: Has Central Asia's oldest metro, opened in 1977.

answers.name: Astana
answers.fact: Renamed Nur-Sultan in 2019, then back to Astana in 2022.

answers.name: Ashgabat
answers.fact: Holds a Guinness record for the most white marble buildings.

answers.name: Yerevan
answers.fact: Founded in 782 BC, which makes it older than Rome.

answers.name: Tbilisi
answers.fact: From the Georgian word for 'warm', after its hot springs.

answers.name: Sana'a
answers.fact: Its old city's tower houses are UNESCO-listed.

answers.name: Manama
answers.fact: Bahrain's capital; Bahrain is linked to Saudi Arabia by a 25 km causeway.

answers.name: Putrajaya
answers.fact: Malaysia's planned administrative capital; Kuala Lumpur is still the official one.

answers.name: Dushanbe
answers.fact: Its name means 'Monday', after the day of an old market.

answers.name: Dili
answers.fact: Capital of Timor-Leste, independent since 2002.

answers.name: Bandar Seri Begawan
answers.fact: Home to Kampong Ayer, a whole village on stilts.

answers.name: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte
answers.fact: Sri Lanka's official capital, where parliament sits on an island in a lake.
